source_title: Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) — All of Us EHR+ phenotype algorithm
scope_note: The executable fixture represents the preferred EHR+ case path and universal control path. It uses normalized, synthetic test inputs. It does not include the alternate EHR-only model or site-specific code/data mappings.
logic_notes: Case cohort excludes age <25 years at latest assessment/exam and any Type 1 diabetes diagnosis at any time.

The EHR case path requires medication support for T2D ICD diagnosis, with the specified outpatient-insulin exception, or abnormal glycemic labs when ICD diagnosis exists without diabetes medication, or non-insulin medication plus abnormal labs when there is no T2D diagnosis.
The preferred EHR+ case path also accepts self-reported T2D.

Universal controls require age >=25, at least one in-person provider visit, at least one glucose measurement, no abnormal random glucose/fasting glucose/HbA1c where available, no diabetes or related condition from EHR/survey, and no diabetes medication.

input_fields.age_at_latest_assessment_years: Age at latest assessment/exam; numeric years.
input_fields.type1_diabetes_any_time: Explicit boolean: any Type 1 diabetes diagnosis at any timepoint.
input_fields.t2d_icd_diagnosis_count: Count of independent T2D ICD diagnosis records.
input_fields.any_diabetes_medication: Explicit boolean: any diabetes medication record.
input_fields.outpatient_insulin_record: Explicit boolean: outpatient insulin treatment record.
input_fields.non_insulin_medication_before_insulin: Explicit boolean: non-insulin diabetes medication before insulin initiation.
input_fields.non_insulin_diabetes_medication: Explicit boolean: prescription for a non-insulin diabetes medication.
input_fields.self_reported_t2d: Explicit boolean: participant survey reports T2D.
input_fields.in_person_provider_visit_count: Count of in-person healthcare provider visits.
input_fields.glucose_measurement_count: Count of glucose measurements in the EHR.
input_fields.fasting_glucose_mg_dl: Fasting glucose in mg/dL; null means unavailable/unknown.
input_fields.fasting_glucose_mmol_l: Fasting glucose in mmol/L; null means unavailable/unknown.
input_fields.hba1c_percent: HbA1c in percent; null means unavailable/unknown.
input_fields.hba1c_mmol_mol: HbA1c in mmol/mol; null means unavailable/unknown.
input_fields.random_glucose_mg_dl: Random glucose in mg/dL; null means unavailable/unknown.
input_fields.random_glucose_mmol_l: Random glucose in mmol/L; null means unavailable/unknown.
input_fields.any_diabetes_diagnosis_or_related_condit: Explicit boolean: any diabetes diagnosis or related condition in EHR or survey at any time.
input_fields.self_reported_diabetes_any: Explicit boolean: any diabetes diagnosis/related condition reported in survey for control assessment.
input_fields.fasting_glucose_mg_dl_available: Explicit boolean indicating whether fasting glucose is available in mg/dL.
input_fields.fasting_glucose_mmol_l_available: Explicit boolean indicating whether fasting glucose is available in mmol/L.
input_fields.hba1c_percent_available: Explicit boolean indicating whether HbA1c is available in percent.
input_fields.hba1c_mmol_mol_available: Explicit boolean indicating whether HbA1c is available in mmol/mol.
input_fields.random_glucose_mg_dl_available: Explicit boolean indicating whether random glucose is available in mg/dL.
input_fields.random_glucose_mmol_l_available: Explicit boolean indicating whether random glucose is available in mmol/L.

proforma_mapping: The fixture uses the HSPTL-PROforma-Subset/1.0 operators and facts.* references only; all inputs are synthetic and all absent/unknown quantitative inputs remain null rather than being defaulted. For optional lab measures, *_available flags explicitly distinguish an unavailable measurement from a normal result; an available measurement with a missing numeric value remains unknown and causes abstention.
